title: Sonic Ascension Records
text: Buy • Sell • Trade Sonic Ascension is paying top dollar for large record collections! Our main interests are rock, soul, jazz, metal, punk, surf, funk, and alternative — but we will consider other records as well. We are interested in private collections, DJ and old radio station stock, and warehouse buyouts. We buy both albums and 45s, and are willing to travel to view collections. Cash paid on the spot! Read more Best vinyl store in Pennsylvania...great prices, excellent owner, very wide genre selection....worth the trip, you won't be disappointed. ★★★★★ Chris Knyrim About Sun — ThuClosed Fri — Sat11:00 — 6:00 Sonic Ascension is a used record and CD store located in Montoursville, PA. Carrying a large selection of classic rock, indie, alternative, punk, and jazz LPs along with soul, country, and soundtrack selections, we also feature a large "$1 Room" with thousands of albums and 45s all priced at $1 each.
